title: The Little Ship That Went Ahead
synopsis: An uncrewed delivery rocket sends Scout ahead. The robotic lander reaches a sunny near-side Moon site with a folded rover and antenna.
continuity_state: Before: The trained crew and assembled Star One are preparing for their own launch; Scout has not yet flown. After: Scout has landed on the Moon and sent a working radio signal; folded rover and payload wait for checks and crew visit. No person or animal is on the Moon yet.
